primary-12col.notes: Standard body grid for most content sections

collage-masonry.notes: Masonry-style with explicit row spans — some cards overlap via negative margin-top

collage-pinboard.notes: Absolute positioning within relative container — hero collage assembly only
collage-pinboard.usage: position: relative on parent; position: absolute on children with varied top/left

feature-asymmetric.notes: Two-column even split for feature sections

card-stack.notes: Responsive card grid — cards stagger with box-shadow paper effect

overlap.notes: Selected collage cards use negative margin-top for layered paper effect

_twist.twistApplied: Collage grid system — 1280px container, standard 12-col body, masonry collage grid with row spans, pinboard absolute-position layer for hero, card rotations ±2deg via nth-child, negative margin-top overlap for layered paper feel.
